results.proof:
by
  have p_eq : ∀ n, p n = fun x : ℝ => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x - i) := by
    intro n
    rcases n with _ | n
    · rw [h0]
      ext x
      simp
    · rw [hp (Nat.succ n) (Nat.succ_pos n)]
  simp_rw [p_eq]
  exact falling_factorial_add n x y
lemmas:
lemma falling_factorial_add (n : ℕ) (x y : ℝ) :
  (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x + y - i)) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i)) := by
  induction' n with n ih
  · simp
  · rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ih, Finset.sum_mul]
    have h_split (k : ℕ) (hk : k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1)) : x + y - n = (x - k) + (y - ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
      have hk_lt := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
      have h_le : k ≤ n := by omega
      have h : (k : ℝ) + ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) = n := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub h_le]
        ring
      linarith
    have h_sum : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) * (x + y - n) =
                 ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) * (x - k) +
                                              ((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) * (y - ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      rw [h_split k hk]
      ring
    rw [h_sum]
    have h_sum2 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) * (x - k) +
                                              ((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) * (y - ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ))) =
                  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i)) +
                                              (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k + 1), (y - i))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      have h1 : ((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) * (x - k) =
                (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i)) := by
        calc ((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) * (x - k)
          _ = (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i)) * ((∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (x - k)) := by ring
          _ = (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) := by rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
          _ = (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i)) := by ring
      have h2 : ((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) * (y - ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
                (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k + 1), (y - i)) := by
        calc ((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) * (y - ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ))
          _ = (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * ((∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i)) * (y - ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by ring
          _ = (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k + 1), (y - i)) := by rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
      rw [h1, h2]
    rw [h_sum2]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have h_S1 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i)) =
                (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) +
                (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (x - i)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have h_term : (Nat.choose n n : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - n), (y - i)) = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (x - i)) := by
        rw [Nat.choose_self, Nat.sub_self, Finset.prod_range_zero]
        ring
      rw [h_term]
    have h_S2 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k + 1), (y - i)) =
                (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (Nat.choose n (k + 1) : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) +
                (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (y - i)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
      have h_term : (Nat.choose n 0 : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range 0, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 0 + 1), (y - i)) = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (y - i)) := by
        rw [Nat.choose_zero_right, Finset.prod_range_zero, Nat.sub_zero]
        ring
      rw [h_term]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      have hk_lt : k < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
      have h_sub : n - (k + 1) + 1 = n - k := by omega
      rw [h_sub]
    rw [h_S1, h_S2]
    have h_rearrange : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) + (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (x - i)) +
                       ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (Nat.choose n (k + 1) : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) + (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (y - i))) =
                       (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i)) +
                                               (Nat.choose n (k + 1) : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i)))) +
                       (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (x - i)) + (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (y - i)) := by
      calc (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) + (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (x - i)) +
           ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (Nat.choose n (k + 1) : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) + (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (y - i)))
        _ = ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) +
             (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (Nat.choose n (k + 1) : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i)))) +
            (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (x - i)) + (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (y - i)) := by ring
        _ = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i)) +
                                    (Nat.choose n (k + 1) : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i)))) +
            (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (x - i)) + (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (y - i)) := by rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [h_rearrange]
    have h_sum_combine : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i)) +
                                                (Nat.choose n (k + 1) : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) =
                         ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (Nat.choose (n + 1) (k + 1) : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      have h_choose : (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) + (Nat.choose n (k + 1) : ℝ) = (Nat.choose (n + 1) (k + 1) : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Nat.cast_add, ← Nat.choose_succ_succ']
      rw [← h_choose]
      ring
    rw [h_sum_combine]
    have h_RHS : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), (Nat.choose (n + 1) k : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1 - k), (y - i)) =
                 (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (Nat.choose (n + 1) (k + 1) : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k), (y - i))) +
                 (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (x - i)) + (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (y - i)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
      have h_term0 : (Nat.choose (n + 1) 0 : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range 0, (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1 - 0), (y - i)) = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (y - i)) := by
        rw [Nat.choose_zero_right, Finset.prod_range_zero, Nat.sub_zero]
        ring
      rw [h_term0]
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have h_termn : (Nat.choose (n + 1) (n + 1) : ℝ) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (x - i)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1 - (n + 1)), (y - i)) = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (x - i)) := by
        rw [Nat.choose_self, Nat.sub_self, Finset.prod_range_zero]
        ring
      rw [h_termn]
      congr 1
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      have hk_lt : k < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
      have h_sub : n + 1 - (k + 1) = n - k := by omega
      rw [h_sub]
    rw [h_RHS]
